description: This file contains unit tests for the ConceptClassValidator class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic for ConceptClass objects.

classes.name: ConceptClassValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ConceptClassValidator's validation methods.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfUserIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that the validator correctly identifies invalid 'name' fields that are null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfDescriptionIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Ensures that validation passes when the 'description' field is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Checks that validation passes when required fields have valid values.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptClassNameAlreadyExist
methods.description: Tests that duplicate ConceptClass names cause validation errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Verifies that field lengths within acceptable limits pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that overly long field values lead to validation errors.
